events.verdict: Porter Jr. (MIL) briefly engages with Middleton (WAS), but disengages and allows him to move freely.
Coulibaly (WAS) initiates illegal body contact to Antetokounmpo (MIL) that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Coulibaly (WAS) places a hand against Antetokounmpo (MIL) while defending him on the perimeter and the contact is marginal.
Middleton (WAS) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly engage and disengage while establishing post position.
Sarr (WAS) initiates illegal contact to Turner (MIL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Turner (MIL) rests an arm against Sarr (WAS) before blocking the shot attempt. The ensuing contact after the blocked shot is incidental.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) gathers the ball and takes three steps to the basket.
Middleton (WAS) rests a hand against Antetokounmpo's (MIL) body and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Sarr (WAS) blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Green (MIL) positions his arm vertically and the contact with Johnson (WAS) after the release of his shot attempt is incidental.
Middleton (WAS) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Johnson (WAS) and Carrington (WAS) both maintain a legal guarding position during Porter Jr.'s (MIL) driving shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (MIL) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps to the basket.
Sarr (WAS) blocks the shot attempt by Antetokounmpo (MIL) and any ensuing contact is incidental.
McCollum (WAS) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps into his shooting motion.
Green (MIL) legally contests McCollum's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) releases away from Sarr (WAS) to receive the throw-in and does not illegally create space.
Sarr (WAS) legally contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
